Setup

Libraries

Code 
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(ggrepel)

Paths

Code 
# Input
metadata_path <-
    "../Crypto_Desjardins_Ashton/results/02.Dataset/metadata.csv"
chromosomes_path <-
    "../Crypto_Desjardins_Ashton/results/02.Dataset/chromosomes.csv"
mapping_stats_desj <- 
    "../Crypto_Desjardins/results/02.Dataset/depth_quality/mapping_stats.tsv"
mapping_stats_asht <- 
    "../Crypto_Ashton/results/02.Dataset/depth_quality/mapping_stats.tsv"
variants_path <- 
    "../Crypto_Desjardins_Ashton/results/02.Dataset/snpeff/variants.tsv"
cnv_path <- 
    "../Crypto_Desjardins_Ashton/results/02.Dataset/cnv/cnv_chromosomes.tsv"

# Output
desj_counts <- 
    "results/tables/snp_counts_desjardins.csv"
ashton_counts <- 
    "results/tables/snp_counts_ashton.csv"

summary_out_path <- 
    "results/tables/per_lineage_summary_stats.tsv"

Metadata

Code 
metadata <- read_csv(metadata_path)
metadata <- metadata %>%
    select(sample, strain, lineage, vni_subdivision)

Count SNPs of each sample

Plots and tables

Using bash, count the number of variants called by Freebayes and filtered by Snippy.
mapping_and_variants filters are:
GT == 1/1
QUAL >= 100
DP >= 10
A0/DP >= 0

Code 
cd /FastData/czirion/WeavePop_Cneoformans/

tail -n +2 Crypto_Desjardins/results/02.Dataset/metadata.csv | cut -d',' -f1 | while read line
do 
    raw=$(grep -v "#" Crypto_Desjardins/results/01.Samples/mapping_and_variants/$line/snps.raw.vcf | wc -l)
    surv=$(grep -v "#" Crypto_Desjardins/results/01.Samples/mapping_and_variants/$line/snps.filt.vcf | wc -l)
    echo $line,$raw,$surv >> analyses/results/tables/snp_counts_desjardins.csv
done 

tail -n +2 Crypto_Ashton/results/02.Dataset/metadata.csv | cut -d',' -f1 | while read line
do 
    raw=$(grep -v "#" Crypto_Ashton/results/01.Samples/mapping_and_variants/$line/snps.raw.vcf | wc -l)
    surv=$(grep -v "#" Crypto_Ashton/results/01.Samples/mapping_and_variants/$line/snps.filt.vcf | wc -l)
    echo $line,$raw,$surv >> analyses/results/tables/snp_counts_ashton.csv
done

Variant counts

Code 
snp_counts_desj <- read_csv(desj_counts, col_names = c("sample", "n_raw", "n_surv"))
snp_counts_asht <- read_csv(ashton_counts, col_names = c("sample", "n_raw", "n_surv"))

snp_counts <- bind_rows(snp_counts_desj, snp_counts_asht)

snp_counts <- snp_counts %>%
        mutate(n_removed = n_raw - n_surv, percent_surv = (n_surv / n_raw)*100)%>%
        right_join(metadata, by = "sample")
Code 
ggplot(snp_counts, aes(y = n_raw, x = lineage)) +
    geom_quasirandom() +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(title = "Raw SNPs", y = "Number of SNPs", x = "Lineage")
Code 
ggplot(snp_counts, aes(y = n_surv, x = lineage)) +
    geom_quasirandom() +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(y = "Number SNPs", x = "Lineage", title = "Surviving SNPs")
Code 
ggplot(snp_counts, aes(y = n_removed, x = lineage)) +
    geom_quasirandom() +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = strain), size = 3, max.overlaps = 5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(y = "Number SNPs", x = "Lineage", title = "Removed SNPs")
Code 
ggplot(snp_counts, aes(y = n_removed, x = lineage)) +
    geom_quasirandom() +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, limits = c(0,30000)) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = strain), size = 3, max.overlaps = 5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(y = "Number SNPs (Truncated)", x = "Lineage", title = "Removed SNPs (Truncated y axis)") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

Code 
ggplot(snp_counts_vni, aes(y = n_raw, x = vni_subdivision)) +
    geom_quasirandom() +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(title = "Raw", y = "Number of SNPs", x = "Sublineage")
Code

    geom_quasirandom() +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(y = "Number SNPs", x = "Sublineage", title = "Surviving")
Code 
ggplot(snp_counts_vni, aes(y = n_removed, x = vni_subdivision)) +
    geom_quasirandom() +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = strain), size = 3, max.overlaps = 2, show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(y = "Number SNPs", x = "Sublineage", title = "Removed")

Identify samples with high heterozigosity

Since mapping_and_variants removes all the heterozygous variants, the samples with a big number of removed variants might have high heterozygosity.

MAPQ

Code 
mapq_desj <- read_delim(mapping_stats_desj, delim = "\t", col_names = TRUE)
mapq_asht <- read_delim(mapping_stats_asht, delim = "\t", col_names = TRUE)
mapq <- bind_rows(mapq_desj, mapq_asht) %>%
    right_join(metadata, by = "sample")
Code 
mapq_summary <- mapq %>%
    select(-sample, -strain)%>%
    group_by(lineage)%>%
    summarize(across(everything(), list(mean = mean), na.rm = TRUE))%>%
    ungroup()%>%
    select(lineage, 
        percent_mapped_mean,
        percent_paired_mean,
        percent_properly_paired_mean,
        percent_low_mapq_mean,
        percent_inter_mapq_mean,
        percent_high_mapq_mean,
        coverage_good_mean,
        coverage_raw_mean
        )

CNVs summary

Code 
cnv <- read_delim(cnv_path, delim = "\t", col_names = TRUE)

chromosomes <- read.delim(
    chromosomes_path,
    header=TRUE,
    sep=",",
    stringsAsFactor = TRUE)
Code 
cnv_sample <- cnv %>%
    filter(cnv != "single_copy")%>%
    left_join(chromosomes, by = "accession")%>%
    group_by(lineage, sample, cnv)%>%
    summarize(n_cnvs = sum(n_cnvs), 
                total_size = sum(total_size), 
                length = sum(length)) %>%
    mutate(percent_coverage = (total_size * 100)/length)%>%
    ungroup()

cnv_summary <- cnv_sample %>%
    select(-sample, - length)%>%
    group_by(lineage, cnv)%>%
    summarize(across(everything(), list(mean = mean, sd = sd), na.rm = TRUE))%>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_wider(
        names_from = cnv,
        values_from = c(n_cnvs_mean, n_cnvs_sd, total_size_mean, total_size_sd, percent_coverage_mean, percent_coverage_sd)
    )

length <- cnv_sample %>%
    select(lineage, length) %>%
    distinct()

cnv_summary

Summary

Code 
summary <- reduce(
    list(cnv_summary, mapq_summary, variants_summary, snp_summary, length, ref_snps),
    left_join,
    by = "lineage"
)

summary <- summary %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 4))) %>%
    select(lineage, 
        percent_mapped_mean, 
        percent_high_mapq_mean,
        coverage_good_mean,
        unique_variants = n_variants,
        n_variants_mean = mean_surv,
        n_snps_ref_strain = n_surv,
        n_deletions_mean = n_cnvs_mean_deletion,
        percent_coverage_deletions_mean = percent_coverage_mean_deletion,
        n_duplications_mean = n_cnvs_mean_duplication,
        percent_coverage_duplications_mean = percent_coverage_mean_duplication,
        length)
